en: A vintage colored postcard showing a large Orthodox-style cathedral with multiple green onion domes and ornate façades. The sky has a gradient from light tan near the horizon to blue at the top. In the upper left corner, German text reads "Libau. Kathedrale." The lower right corner has small text identifying the source. The style and wear suggest an early 20th‑century printed postcard.
